Author: WoshiDev
Name: Sub Salvage
Punchline: Vendor-sells submarine loot, keeping 1 of each item.
Description: Run /salvage with a merchant's shop or a retainer open. Sells the Salvaged accessories, the MOJ/OJ gems and ingots, and any items you add to its list, leaving 1 of each (NQ and HQ) in your bags.
